Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3519-3520)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.

Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3501-3503)

dimensions.assessment: Affects the Office of the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation within the SEC and members of the public providing information to it.
dimensions.evidence: Actions taken by the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation under this subsection shall not be a ``collection of information''

dimensions.assessment: Relieves an office of specific paperwork review procedures while keeping certain notification requirements intact.
dimensions.evidence: the Commission shall not be required-- (i) to submit a collection of information by the Advocate to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget

dimensions.assessment: No data or estimates regarding federal spending or economic impacts are provided in the source text.
Amends the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 regarding Paperwork Reduction Act exemptions for a single office.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to specify that actions of the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation are not a collection of information under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change governing the specified office's information collection procedures.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill exempts certain actions of the Office of the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation from the Paperwork Reduction Act, modifying information collection requirements for that specific office.
